events.title: Russian drone hits train near Ukraine-Poland border soon after dignitaries passed through
events.description: A Russian drone struck a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after senior visiting officials, including the former prime ministers of the U.K. and Sweden, passed through.

events.title: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
events.description: New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.

events.title: Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows
events.description: Chancellor Friedrich Merz has urged his party to stay disciplined as pressure grows over his leadership. Meanwhile, Germany's homeownership rate has fallen to its lowest level in 20 years. DW has the latest.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Germany news: Merz urges CDU discipline as pressure grows

events.title: Ukraine: AfD questions German aid, Berlin remains committed
events.description: Emboldened by its win in Saxony-Anhalt, the far-right Alternative for Germany wants the government to change its Ukraine and Russia policies. Berlin is staying the course, but support is fading — especially in the east.

events.title: Berlin businesswoman charged with spying for Russia
events.description: Prosecutors say the Berlin marketing executive used her political and military contacts to help a Russian intelligence officer gain access to influential circles and seek information on German defense policy.

events.title: India women's team refuse Asia Cup cricket trophy from Pakistan minister
events.description: After beating Sri Lanka to win a record eighth Asia Cup title, the Indian women's cricket team skipped the trophy presentation with Pakistani Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi.

events.title: Pay to ghost your boss: Japan's resignation business
events.description: Resignation agencies in Japan help employees leave their jobs seamlessly in just 15 minutes. Young people are especially eager to use their services.

events.title: Finland: EU leaders meet to forge new Arctic policy
events.description: European leaders are meeting over shipping, resources and security in the region amid pressure from the US, China and Russia. The EU sees the Arctic as key to its future security as melting ice makes it more accessible.

events.title: Keziah Jones goes symphonic
events.description: This week arts24 talks to Nigerian Blues Funk Artist Keziah Jones ahead of his Symphonic premier at la Scène Musicale on September 29 as part of Jazz & Musique du Monde season. He tells FRANCE 24's Marjorie Hache about his music and about working with arranger Pierre Bertrand. Plus, we take a look at new releases by Beck, Miley Cyrus and Beabadobee.

events.title: Thousands rally in support of Brazil's Lula as election campaigning heats up
events.description: With Brazil set to hold a Presidential election on October 4th, supporters of both incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula Da Silva and his main opponent Flavio Bolsonaro have been taking to the streets. Polls have the candidates, who are on opposite ends of political spectrum, neck and neck.

events.title: Dozens arrested as Turkish police raid LGBTQ bars, activists' homes
events.description: Turkish police on Sunday made dozens of arrests in a slew of raids on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ activists. Authorities said the raids came in the context of the "Decade of the Family" proclaimed by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan, aimed at "protecting our children, the institution of the family and social order".

events.title: A 'complicated autumn' awaits Sweden after knife-edge vote
events.description: Sweden's general election remained too close to call early Monday, with nearly 90 percent of votes counted. Four opposition parties led by Social Democrat Magdalena Andersson held a one-seat parliamentary lead over Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's right-wing bloc, which includes the Sweden Democrats, as both leaders said they were ready to govern.

events.title: Woman, 54, gives birth after using embryo frozen for 22 years
events.description: A Greek woman has given birth aged 54, beating a government deadline to use one of her embryos, which had been frozen for 22 years.

events.title: Trump calls for Irish reunification - and claims 'it will happen eventually'
events.description: Donald Trump said he would "love to see" a reunified Ireland, claiming "it's going to happen eventually".
events.ticker_label: 💥 Trump calls for Irish reunification - and claims 'it will happen eventually'

events.title: Pope celebrates his 71st birthday but it's Vatican employees who get the gift
events.description: Pope Leo XIV has celebrated his 71st birthday but it is Vatican employees who got the gift

events.title: Houthis seize 2 strategic Red Sea islands, and other Mideast developments
events.description: Yemen's Houthi rebels have seized the strategic islands of Greater and Lesser Hanish in the southern Red Sea

events.title: Arctic thaw opens shipping routes as Russian buildup stokes security fears
events.description: Top European leaders are meeting in Finland to focus on the Arctic

events.title: Sweden's next government uncertain with thin lead for left-wing opposition
events.description: Sweden faces a potentially long wait for a new government as preliminary election results show a thin and still-uncertain lead for the left-leaning opposition, while a hard-right anti-immigration party saw its support slip

events.title: A Muslim region in the southern Philippines votes in first parliamentary elections
events.description: A predominantly Muslim region in the southern Philippines held its first parliamentary elections on Monday

events.title: Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen
events.description: Fatimah* was 13 when she was married off to an older man. Two years later, she gave birth to twin daughters.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Married at 13, pregnant and starving: Child brides of Yemen

events.title: Charlie Kirk statue defaced with red paint, Jesus crossed out days after 1-year mark of assassination
events.description: Red paint was smeared across the Charlie Kirk statue at Turning Point USA's Phoenix headquarters, with a Christian tribute defaced days after unveiling.

events.title: Ohio man convicted after trying to shoot ex-wife at point-blank range inside restaurant in chilling video
events.description: Security video shows Matthew Exton thrusting a handgun at point-blank range near his ex-wife's head inside a Toledo restaurant before a waiter acted.

events.title: Could Africa be the next AI frontier as US and Europe hit limits?
events.description: U.S. companies are winning massive data center and AI deals across Africa, including a $6.2 billion project in Lesotho for hydropower and computing.

events.title: Indonesian passenger ship carrying 240 people loses contact in Java Sea, search underway
events.description: The Virgo Transport 8 vanished crossing the Java Sea with 240 people aboard en route from Surabaya to Banjarmasin, triggering an urgent search.

events.title: Saudi Arabia tells Trump now is the time for military action as Iran-backed Houthis advance
events.description: Houthi forces seized Perim island and key positions along Yemen's Bab al-Mandab Strait as Saudi Arabia urged Trump to take direct military action.

events.title: Philippines defense chief calls out China after note interrupts remarks at Seoul forum: 'Coercion, bullying'
events.description: Gilberto Teodoro read aloud a note from China handed to him mid-speech at the Seoul Defense Dialogue, calling it actual coercion and bullying.
